verdict.rationale: Snyk ships a built-in, LLM-driven Remediation Agent. It scans the project, builds a fix plan, applies the fixes and verifies the result. Users can delegate this directly in the Snyk CLI via `snyk fix --agentic` as a human-in-the-loop interactive session, backed by DeepCode AI autofixes. Missing for 10: delegation beyond vulnerability remediation (general-purpose tasks), an in-app assistant in the web portal, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent's behavior.
